verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of pre-built project or task templates, template galleries, or onboarding via templates anywhere in ClickUp's docs or community citations. Templates are a plausible and common capability for a project-management tool, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack substantiates it. Missing for 10: any docs reference to a template library, template creation/sharing, or a PM using templates to start a project.
